title: Mini-Grid for Post-Harvest Processing — Kabale District
summary: A 30 kW solar mini-grid powering post-harvest processing equipment for Irish potato and bean farmers in Kabale District, Western Uganda.
description: Kabale District is Uganda's major Irish potato and legume growing zone in the highland area. Post-harvest losses due to lack of processing and storage energy were estimated at 35%. This project installed a 30 kW solar mini-grid at the Kabale District Farmers' Cooperative Union premises, providing reliable power for potato washing, grading, and cold storage equipment, as well as bean threshers and packaging machinery. The mini-grid also supplies electricity to an adjacent health centre and school, providing broader community benefit. A community energy committee manages tariff collection and basic maintenance.
locationNote: Kabale District Farmers' Cooperative Union premises, highland area
outcomes: Post-harvest losses reduced by 28%; 400 farmers connected to processing services; health centre and school electrified; energy committee operational.
